description: Neural Knights is a team of developers and problem-solvers participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We bring skills in MERN/full-stack development, backend, AI/ML, databases, and system design. We' re building a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer to make space science interactive and engaging. We're looking for teammates skilled in game development, Three.js/WebGL, UI/UX, 3D/animation, or space science interactive.
